title: The Thrill of the Fight – VR Boxing (Build 4641271)

system_requirements.Processor: Intel Core i5-4590/AMD Ryzen 5 1600 equivalent or better
system_requirements.Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970, AMD Radeon R9 290 equivalent or better
system_requirements.VR Support: SteamVR or Oculus Rift (Oculus Quest not supported). Requires motion controllers. Room Scale 2m by 2m (6.5ft by 6.5ft) area required. Joystick movement not supported.
